ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its melodic thrash sound fits my interest in Chuck and the heavier In Flames albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The mix of heavy riffs and unusual melodies appeals to me after Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: Curse; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal direction interests me, but I would prioritize The War Within this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Trapt       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits the accessible hard rock side of my history, but I want something heavier today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ascendancy       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Melodic riffs and aggressive vocals strongly match my interest in Advance And Vanquish and Colony.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its balance of aggression and memorable hooks suits my recent interest in heavier rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Crusade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash direction appeals to me, but I would try Ascendancy first rather than choose both now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Natural Selection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It connects with my melodic hard rock listening, though it is less compelling for my current heavier mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lonely Position of Neutral; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its softer alternative rock direction is less appealing than the heavier albums I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lost and Found       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves sound compatible with Ten Thousand Fists, but my other selections already cover that mood.
